targets.description: sample name -> target. The name must match the one stage 1 keyed its outputs on.

additionalProperties.description: One refinement target: an annotated dataset, its decisions, and where the six per-method models are written.

adata.description: The .h5ad stage 1 annotated. Must be the same object -- the geneset scores and decisions are keyed on its barcodes.

batch_key.description: .obs column scVI corrects on. Null/absent for a single-sample target, which also forces the single-batch scib fallback.

counts_layer.description: Raw counts layer for scVI. NOT a normalised one -- scVI models counts directly.

covariates.description: .obs columns passed to scVI as continuous covariates. Verified safe here: SCANVI.from_scvi_model copies the scVI setup args through, so unlike SOLO it does not reject a covariate-carrying source model.

methods.description: Marker methods to refine. Each is an independent tune+fit, so this is the SLURM array width.

seeds.description: Per-target override of the top-level `seeds` block (same keys; the target's values win). Added 2026-09-14: chapter 3 runs `quantile_scope: geneset` for At_tip_ls_H and `group` for the Medicago target.

annotation_dir.description: Stage 1 output root holding {sample}/{method}/. Default: results/annotation.

cache_dir.description: Regenerable caches: OrthoFinder runs, prepared primary-transcript proteomes, gene maps and preflight validation. Kept out of `output_dir` so the deliverables tree holds only what you would read, and so this directory is safe to delete at the cost of one OrthoFinder rerun. Default: a cache/annotation/ sibling of output_dir.

ontology_file.description: Plant Ontology .obo, read only to turn PO ids into readable class names for .obs. Optional: without it the annotation columns carry bare PO ids.

ontology_extensions.description: Extension .obo files grafted into the ontology, matching annotation_config so a group named with a grafted id (a NODULE: nodule cell type) shows its name in .obs rather than the bare id. Relative paths resolve next to ontology_file.

seeds.description: How the confident core of each geneset is chosen. Both values are placeholders -- they yield ~7.5% of cells as seeds on MtTip_noHVG, which is deliberate but untested against propagation quality.

quantile.description: Per-geneset score quantile a cell must clear. Per geneset, not global: scores are not comparable across genesets.

margin.description: Z-score gap the best geneset must beat the runner-up by, else the cell is left for scANVI.

min_seed_cells.description: Classes with fewer seeds are returned to Unassigned. Guess; scANVI's real floor is unknown.

quantile_scope.description: Combined run only. 'group' (default): the seed quantile is taken over all cells a review group wins, so a group uniting two clusters with different score scales seeds only the higher-scoring one. 'geneset': the quantile is taken per winning member geneset within the group (falls back to the group cutoff below 10 cells); exclusivity is unchanged. Added 2026-09-14 for chapter 3 (C2 addendum: nuclei-only pericycle on At_tip_ls_H).

min_confidence.description: Max-posterior floor. PLACEHOLDER -- the 0.8 default was set against a nearest-centroid softmax, which is far flatter than a real scANVI posterior. Calibrate on the first run.

max_novelty_ratio.description: Measured: 1.25 catches 50.3% of held-out orphans for 0.7% false positives.

tune.description: scib-metric autotuning. Off until step 5 lands.

n_trials.description: 30 is a screening budget, not an optimum -- 6 methods x 200 trials with scib per trial is 240-600 GPU-hours.

tune_metric.description: The scib strings select the scib tuner (scvi dispatches on the metric name). "Total" is the 0.6 bio / 0.4 batch aggregate. A single-batch target falls back to "Bio conservation".

model_params.description: Passed to the scVI constructor when tune is off. Empty means scvi's own defaults.

scanvi_params.description: Passed to SCANVI.from_scvi_model. n_hidden/n_latent etc. are inherited from the scVI model and warned about if repeated here.

n_samples_per_label.description: scANVI oversamples labelled cells per epoch. Guards against the seed set being a small fraction of the data.

embedding.description: Neighbours/UMAP/Leiden on the scANVI latent, via shared/dimred.py.

compare_models.description: Also embed every OTHER latent the run fitted -- the base scVI and whichever comparison arms ran -- with these same settings, into that model's own directory. On by default: the arms exist to be compared and the comparison is visual. Costs one neighbours+UMAP per extra latent.

genes.description: Genes whose expression is embedded in the HTML. Full expression cannot be inlined (62,750 x 52,689), so only these columns travel. No real list exists yet -- until one does, treat the panels as a UI test.

max_points.description: Cells drawn in the report scatter. Above this the payload is subsampled.
